title: tetrastigma pisicarpum
intro: Tetrastigma pisicarpum, commonly known as the Chinese grapevine or Five-angled creeper, is a plant species belonging to the family Vitaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant is also reported to exhibit therapeutic actions like antioxidant, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Tetrastigma pisicarpum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
